description: Create a new project (POST /v1/projects). name = display name; slug = a short URL-safe identifier (/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/). Pro caps at 5 projects, Team unlimited, Free cannot create (403). As a mutation, session-authenticated requests enforce Origin/Referer (dashboard-driven).

slug.description: Short URL-safe identifier (/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/, up to 32 chars, starts with a lowercase letter, hyphens allowed)

name: create_project
